## Whole Orchard Recycling - Space for time 2023

This space for time substitution experiment was conducted in four experimental almond orchards that have whole orchard recycling (WOR) and control treatments. These 4 fields were each sampled in 4 replicate blocks per treatment in Summer 2023 at the University of California Kearney Agricultural Research and Extension Center (UC KARE) located in Fresno County, CA. The soils were first seived to <2 mm and then separated into POM and MAOM fractions. All POM and MAOM samples were air-dried, diluted to 10% (w/w) with pre-ground potassium bromide (KBr), and then analyzed by DRIFTS spectroscopy. Spectral subtractions were performed in OMNIC, to remove the absorbance of inorganic covalent bonds such as Si-O (which compose the mineral contribution of soil).

Space for Time Substitution Design (Fields + Years):
Field K32 (est. 2008) 15 yrs  |   33 tons wood chips/acre   | Blocks 2,3,4,6
Field K74 (est. 2017)  6 yrs  |   85 tons wood chips/acre   | Blocks 11,12,13,14
Field K92 (est. 2019)  4 yrs  |   61 tons wood chips/acre   | Blocks 1,2,3,5
Field K95 (est. 2020)  3 yrs  |   60 tons wood chips/acre   | Blocks 1,2,3,4

POM and MAOM Sample (#) shorthand key:
   [K92]         [K31]        [K74]          [K95]
1. B1 - CN    9.  B2 - CN   17. B11 - CN    25. B1 - CN
2. B2 - CN    10. B3 - CN   18. B12 - CN    26. B2 - CN
3. B3 - CN    11. B4 - CN   19. B13 - CN    27. B3 - CN
4. B5 - CN    12. B6 - CN   20. B14 - CN    28. B4 - CN
5. B1 - WC    13. B2 - WC   21. B11 - WC    29. B1 - WC
6. B2 - WC    14. B3 - WC   22. B12 - WC    30. B2 - WC
7. B3 - WC    15. B4 - WC   23. B13 - WC    31. B3 - WC
8. B5 - WC    16. B6 - WC   24. B14 - WC    32. B4 - WC 
Note: CN = Control, WC = Wood Chip treatments

## Load Libraries and Import the metadata
```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(rstatix)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# Stats
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)     # Provides p-values for lmer models
library(car)
library(DescTools)  
library(rcompanion) # For plotNormalHistogram
library(emmeans)

# Load the Metadata and Subtraction Index Values
SFT_meta <- readRDS(file = "SFT_2023_Metadata.rds")
SFT_ss_index <- readRDS(file = "Helix_Index123.rds")
```
The SFT_meta dataframe includes is for 32 soil samples (4 fields * 2 treatments * 4 blocks) that were sieved to <2 mm prior to collection of the following data:
- Gravimetric Moisture Content (%)
- Soil pH [20 g of soil + 20 mL of DIW]
- SOM content by LOI (%)
- Water Holding Capacity (%)
- 18O Resipiration Rate (mg CO2 / 24 hrs)
- 16O Respiration Rate (mg Co2 / 24 hrs)
- Dissolved Organic Carbon (mg C / g soil ODW)
- Dissolved Organic Nitrogen (mg N / g soil ODW)
- Microbial Biomass Carbon (mg MBC / g ODW)
- Microbial Biomass Nitrogen (mg MBN / g ODW)
- Total C [of the <2 mm soil] (%)
- Total N [of the <2 mm soil] (%)
- Total C [of the POM fraction] (%)
- Total N [of the POM fraction] (%)
- Total C [of the MAOM fraction] (%)
- Total N [of the MAOM fraction] (%)
- CN_Ratio (TC % / TN %)
- POM_CN_Ratio (POM TC % / POM TN %)
- MAOM_CN_Ratio (MAOM TC % / MAOM TN %)

# Meta Data Means
```{r}
# Means for Treatments (does not separate by Field)
meta_means <- SFT_meta %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    pH_mean = mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
    pH_sd   = sd(pH, na.rm = TRUE),

    SOM_mean = mean(OM_Content, na.rm = TRUE),
    SOM_sd = sd(OM_Content, na.rm = TRUE),
    TC_mean = mean(TC, na.rm = TRUE),
    TC_sd = sd(TC, na.rm = TRUE),
    TN_mean = mean(TN, na.rm = TRUE),
    TN_sd = sd(TN, na.rm = TRUE),
    CN_Ratio_mean = mean(CN_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    CN_Ratio_sd = sd(CN_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),

    POM_CN_Ratio_mean = mean(POM_CN_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    POM_CN_Ratio_sd = sd(POM_CN_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_CN_Ratio_mean = mean(MAOM_CN_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_CN_Ratio_sd = sd(MAOM_CN_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),

    POM_TC_mean = mean(POM_TC, na.rm = TRUE),
    POM_TC_sd = sd(POM_TC, na.rm = TRUE),
    POM_TN_mean = mean(POM_TN, na.rm = TRUE),
    POM_TN_sd = sd(POM_TN, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_TC_mean = mean(MAOM_TC, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_TC_sd = sd(MAOM_TC, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_TN_mean = mean(MAOM_TN, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_TN_sd = sd(MAOM_TN, na.rm = TRUE),

    POM_13C_mean = mean(POM_13C, na.rm = TRUE),
    POM_13C_sd = sd(POM_13C, na.rm = TRUE),
    POM_15N_mean = mean(POM_15N, na.rm = TRUE),
    POM_15N_sd = sd(POM_15N, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_13C_mean = mean(MAOM_13C, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_13C_sd = sd(MAOM_13C, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_15N_mean = mean(MAOM_15N, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_15N_sd = sd(MAOM_15N, na.rm = TRUE),

    # --- Spectral indices ---
    POM_Decomposition_Index_mean  = mean(POM_Decomposition_Index, na.rm = TRUE),
    POM_Decomposition_Index_sd    = sd(POM_Decomposition_Index, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_Decomposition_Index_mean = mean(MAOM_Decomposition_Index, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_Decomposition_Index_sd   = sd(MAOM_Decomposition_Index, na.rm = TRUE),

    POM_Recalcitrance_Index_mean  = mean(POM_Recalcitrance_Index, na.rm = TRUE),
    POM_Recalcitrance_Index_sd    = sd(POM_Recalcitrance_Index, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_Recalcitrance_Index_mean = mean(MAOM_Recalcitrance_Index, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAOM_Recalcitrance_Index_sd   = sd(MAOM_Recalcitrance_Index, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    "POM Aliphatic C : Aromatic C_mean"  = POM_Decomposition_Index_mean,
    "POM Aliphatic C : Aromatic C_sd"    = POM_Decomposition_Index_sd,
    "MAOM Aliphatic C : Aromatic C_mean" = MAOM_Decomposition_Index_mean,
    "MAOM Aliphatic C : Aromatic C_sd"   = MAOM_Decomposition_Index_sd,
    "POM Aromatic C : Carboxylic C_mean"  = POM_Recalcitrance_Index_mean,
    "POM Aromatic C : Carboxylic C_sd"    = POM_Recalcitrance_Index_sd,
    "MAOM Aromatic C : Carboxylic C_mean" = MAOM_Recalcitrance_Index_mean,
    "MAOM Aromatic C : Carboxylic C_sd"   = MAOM_Recalcitrance_Index_sd
  )

print(meta_means)

# Means for Treatment x Field

# Full <2 mm soil metadata
# Vector of columns to exclude (POM/MAOM-related)
# Columns to exclude (all POM/MAOM-related)
exclude_cols <- c(
  "POM_13C", "POM_15N", "MAOM_13C", "MAOM_15N",
  "POM_TC", "POM_TN", "MAOM_TC", "MAOM_TN",
  "POM_CN_Ratio", "MAOM_CN_Ratio",
  "percent_MAOM", "percent_POM",
  "MAOM_Index_I", "MAOM_Index_II",
  "POM_Index_I", "POM_Index_II",
  "MAOM_Decomposition_Index", "MAOM_Recalcitrance_Index",
  "POM_Decomposition_Index", "POM_Recalcitrance_Index"
)

meta_means_field_2mm <- SFT_meta %>%
  # keep everything except POM/MAOM variables
  select(-all_of(exclude_cols)) %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Field) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd   = ~ sd(.x,   na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

meta_means_field_2mm

# Export if desired
write.csv(
  meta_means_field_2mm,
  file = "meta_means_2mm.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Proof of C removal (supplemental methods figure)
# Plotting the TC removal from NaOCl oxidation
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggtext)

# Load the data
SFT_subtraction <- readRDS(file = "POM_MAOM_TC_TN_Subtraction.rds")
str(SFT_subtraction)

# Create a new column that combines Block and Treatment for x-axis labeling
SFT_subtraction <- SFT_subtraction %>%
  mutate(Block_Treatment = paste0(Treatment, "_", "B", Block))

# Combine Field, Treatment, and Block into one label for the x-axis
SFT_subtraction <- SFT_subtraction %>%
  mutate(Field_Treatment_Block = paste(Field, Treatment, Block, sep = "_"))

# Reshape the data to long format for easier plotting of both C_total and C_remaining
SFT_long <- SFT_subtraction %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(C_total, C_remaining), names_to = "C_type", values_to = "C_value")

# Define custom colors for treatments
label_df <- SFT_subtraction %>%
  distinct(Field_Treatment_Block, Treatment) %>%
  mutate(color = ifelse(Treatment == "CN", "#1F77B4", "#FF7F0E"),
         label = paste0("<span style='color:", color, ";'>", Field_Treatment_Block, "</span>"))

label_vec <- setNames(label_df$label, label_df$Field_Treatment_Block)

# Create the plot
C_removal_plot <- ggplot(SFT_long, aes(x = Field_Treatment_Block, y = C_value, color = C_type, group = C_type)) +
  # Add lines for C_total and C_remaining
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  # Facet by SOM
  facet_wrap(~ SOM) +
  # Customize labels
  labs(
    x = "Field x Treatment x Block",
    y = "Total C (%)",
    title = "Total C and C Removal by NaOCl oxidation",
    color = "Total C (%)"
  ) +
  # Adjust the theme for readability
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),  # Bold and set font size for axis titles
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),  # Set font size for axis text
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  # Apply color to x-axis labels by Treatment
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_vec)

C_removal_plot

# To save
png("SFT_TC_removal.png", width=13, height=6, bg="white", res=600, units="in")
print(C_removal_plot)
dev.off()
```

## Plotting the POM and MAOM data for TC
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Select the columns you want to include
TC_columns <- c("TC", "POM_TC", "MAOM_TC")

# Gather the data to reshape it and filter columns
SFT_Cmeta_long <- SFT_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment, TC, POM_TC, MAOM_TC) %>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "Value", -c(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment))

# Calculate averages for each Block + Treatment combination within each Field
averages <- SFT_Cmeta_long %>%
  group_by(Field, Treatment, Parameter) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Value),
            SE = sd(Value) / sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup()

# Define custom order for Field and Parameter
field_order <- c("K95", "K92", "K74", "K31")
parameter_order <- c("TC", "POM_TC", "MAOM_TC", "Ratio_POM_MAOM")

# Apply the custom order to Field and Parameter as factors
SFT_Cmeta_long <- SFT_Cmeta_long %>%
  mutate(
    Field = factor(Field, levels = field_order),
    Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = parameter_order)
  )

averages <- averages %>%
  mutate(
    Field = factor(Field, levels = field_order),
    Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = parameter_order)
  )

# Create the plot with the custom order
TC_bxplt <- ggplot(SFT_Cmeta_long, aes(x = Field, y = Value, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), show.legend = TRUE) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "pointrange", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = averages, aes(x = Field, y = Mean, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE), 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
  labs(
    title = "Soil Carbon Data",
    y = "Total Carbon Content (%)",
    x = "Years Since WOR"
  ) +
  theme_gray() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CN" = "#1F77B4", "WC" = "#FF7F0E"), labels = c("CN" = "Control", "WC" = "WOR")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("K95" = "3", "K92" = "4", "K74" = "6", "K31" = "15")) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Parameter,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2,
    labeller = labeller(
      Parameter = c(
        "TC" = "<2 mm Soil TC",
        "MAOM_TC" = "MAOM TC",
        "POM_TC" = "POM TC",
        "Ratio_POM_MAOM" = "POM TC : MAOM TC"
      )
    )
  )

# Print the plot
print(TC_bxplt)

## Figure Style Revision ##
TC_bxplt <- ggplot(SFT_Cmeta_long, aes(x = Field, y = Value, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), show.legend = TRUE) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "pointrange", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = averages, aes(x = Field, y = Mean, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE), 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
  labs(y = "Total Carbon (%)", x = "Years Since WOR") +
  theme_gray(base_size = 12) + 
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CN" = "#1F77B4", "WC" = "#FF7F0E"), labels = c("CN" = "Control", "WC" = "WOR")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("K95" = "3", "K92" = "4", "K74" = "6", "K31" = "15")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Parameter, labeller = labeller(
      Parameter = c(
        "TC" = "<2 mm Soil",
        "MAOM_TC" = "MAOM",
        "POM_TC" = "POM")))

# Print the combined plot
print(TC_bxplt)

# Save the plot as PNG
png("SFT_TC_bxplt.png", width = 12, height = 6, bg = "white", res = 600, units = "in")
print(TC_bxplt)
dev.off()
```

## Plotting the POM and MAOM data for TN
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Select the columns you want to include
TN_columns <- c("TN", "POM_TN", "MAOM_TN")

# Gather the data to reshape it and filter columns
SFT_Nmeta_long <- SFT_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment, TN, POM_TN, MAOM_TN) %>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "Value", -c(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment))

# Define custom order for Field
field_order <- c("K95", "K92", "K74", "K31")
parameter_order <- c("TN", "POM_TN", "MAOM_TN")

# Calculate averages for each Block + Treatment combination within each Field
averages <- SFT_Nmeta_long %>%
  group_by(Field, Treatment, Parameter) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Value),
            SE = sd(Value) / sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup()

# Ensure averages Field is a factor with specified levels
averages$Field <- factor(averages$Field, levels = field_order)

# Create a new column that combines Field and Parameter for faceting
SFT_Nmeta_long <- SFT_Nmeta_long %>%
  mutate(Field_Parameter = paste(Field, Parameter, sep = "_"))

averages <- averages %>%
  mutate(Field_Parameter = paste(Field, Parameter, sep = "_"))

# Reorder the Parameter variable of the facets
SFT_Nmeta_long$Parameter <- factor(SFT_Nmeta_long$Parameter, levels = c("TN", "MAOM_TN", "POM_TN"))
averages$Parameter <- factor(averages$Parameter, levels = c("TN", "POM_TN", "MAOM_TN"))

# Convert Field to a factor with the specified levels
SFT_Nmeta_long$Field <- factor(SFT_Nmeta_long$Field, levels = field_order)
SFT_Nmeta_long$Parameter <- factor(SFT_Nmeta_long$Parameter, levels = parameter_order)

# Create a single boxplot for %N values with customized labels
TN_bxplt <- ggplot(SFT_Nmeta_long, aes(x = Field, y = Value, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), show.legend = TRUE) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "pointrange", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = averages, aes(x = Field, y = Mean, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE), 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
  labs(y = "Total Nitrogen (%)", x = "Years Since WOR") +
  theme_gray(base_size = 12) + 
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CN" = "#1F77B4", "WC" = "#FF7F0E"), labels = c("CN" = "Control", "WC" = "WOR")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("K95" = "3", "K92" = "4", "K74" = "6", "K31" = "15")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Parameter, labeller = labeller(
      Parameter = c(
        "TN" = "<2 mm Soil",
        "MAOM_TN" = "MAOM",
        "POM_TN" = "POM")))

# Print the combined plot
print(TN_bxplt)

# To save
png("SFT_TN_bxplt.png", width=12, height=6, bg="white", res=600, units="in")
print(TN_bxplt)
dev.off()
```

# Relabel and plot for publication
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Prepare data
CNR_df <- SFT_meta %>%
  select(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment, POM_CN_Ratio, MAOM_CN_Ratio) %>%
  filter(!is.na(POM_CN_Ratio), !is.na(MAOM_CN_Ratio))

# Calculate regression statistics per Treatment group
reg_stats <- CNR_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    slope = coef(lm(MAOM_CN_Ratio ~ POM_CN_Ratio))[2],
    intercept = coef(lm(MAOM_CN_Ratio ~ POM_CN_Ratio))[1],
    r = cor(POM_CN_Ratio, MAOM_CN_Ratio),
    p = cor.test(POM_CN_Ratio, MAOM_CN_Ratio)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = sprintf(
      "Treatment %s:\ny = %.2fX + %.2f\nr = %.2f, P %s %.3g",
      Treatment,
      slope, intercept, r,
      ifelse(p < 0.001, "<", "="),
      ifelse(p < 0.001, 0.001, p)
    )
  )

# Ensure factor order for Field so shapes appear in desired order
CNR_df$Field <- factor(CNR_df$Field, levels = c("K95", "K92", "K74", "K31"))

# Base plot
CNR_scatter <- ggplot(CNR_df, aes(x = POM_CN_Ratio, y = MAOM_CN_Ratio, color = Treatment)) +
  # Add faint 1:1 line first (behind data)
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Field), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = Treatment), method = "lm", se = FALSE, size = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = "POM C:N Ratio",
    y = "MAOM C:N Ratio",
    color = "Treatment",
    shape = "Years\nSince\nWOR"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(6.5, 16.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(6.5, 16.5)) +
  theme_gray(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.box.just = "left",
    legend.key.height = unit(18, "pt"),  # Increase vertical spacing between shapes
    legend.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt")     # Add small buffer between legend entries
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("CN" = "#1F77B4", "WC" = "#FF7F0E"),
    labels = c("CN" = "Control", "WC" = "WOR")
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("K95" = 16,  # circle
               "K92" = 17,  # triangle
               "K74" = 15,  # square
               "K31" = 3),  # plus
    labels = c("K95" = "3",
               "K92" = "4",
               "K74" = "6",
               "K31" = "15")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(size = 4)
    )
  )

# Add regression labels
CNR_scatter <- CNR_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = 9, y = 16,
           label = reg_stats$label[reg_stats$Treatment == "CN"],
           color = "#1F77B4", hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 9, y = 14,
           label = reg_stats$label[reg_stats$Treatment == "WC"],
           color = "#FF7F0E", hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold")

# Display the plot
print(CNR_scatter)

# Save the plot
png("SFT_CN_scatter_Year.png", width = 6, height = 6, bg = "white", res = 600, units = "in")
print(CNR_scatter)
dev.off()
```


## Plotting 13C and 15 POM and MAOM
```{r}
# Select the columns you want to include
iso_columns <- c("POM_13C", "POM_15N", "MAOM_13C", "MAOM_15N")

# Gather the data to reshape and filter columns
SFT_iso_long <- SFT_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment, all_of(iso_columns)) %>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "Value", -c(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment))

# Define custom order for Field and Parameter
field_order <- c("K95", "K92", "K74", "K31")
parameter_order <- c("POM_13C", "MAOM_13C", "POM_15N", "MAOM_15N")

# Calculate averages for each Field + Treatment + Parameter
averages <- SFT_iso_long %>%
  group_by(Field, Treatment, Parameter) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
            SE = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

# Factor levels for fields and parameters to control order in plot
SFT_iso_long <- SFT_iso_long %>%
  mutate(
    Field = factor(Field, levels = field_order),
    Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = parameter_order)
  )
averages <- averages %>%
  mutate(
    Field = factor(Field, levels = field_order),
    Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = parameter_order)
  )

# Custom facet labels
facet_labels <- c(
  "POM_13C"  = "POM δ13C",
  "POM_15N"  = "POM δ15N",
  "MAOM_13C" = "MAOM δ13C",
  "MAOM_15N" = "MAOM δ15N"
)

# Create the plot

  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), show.legend = TRUE) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "pointrange",
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = averages,
                aes(x = Field, y = Mean, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
  labs(y = "Isotopic Value (‰)", x = "Years Since WOR") +
  theme_gray(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CN" = "#1F77B4", "WC" = "#FF7F0E"),
                    labels = c("CN" = "Control", "WC" = "WOR")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("K95" = "3", "K92" = "4",
                              "K74" = "6", "K31" = "15")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Parameter, labeller = labeller(Parameter = facet_labels))

# Print the plot

# Save the plot
png("SFT_iso_bxplt.png", width = 12, height = 6, bg = "white", res = 600, units = "in")
print(iso_bxplt)
```

## POM δ13C vs MAOM δ13C
```{r}
# Prepare dataset and filter missing values
C13_df <- SFT_iso_long %>%
  filter(Parameter %in% c("POM_13C", "MAOM_13C")) %>%
  select(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment, Parameter, Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = Value) %>%
  filter(!is.na(POM_13C), !is.na(MAOM_13C))

# Compute regression stats by Treatment
reg_stats_13C <- C13_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    slope = coef(lm(MAOM_13C ~ POM_13C))[2],
    intercept = coef(lm(MAOM_13C ~ POM_13C))[1],
    r = cor(POM_13C, MAOM_13C),
    p = cor.test(POM_13C, MAOM_13C)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = sprintf("Treatment %s:\ny = %.2fX + %.2f\nr = %.2f, P %s %.3g",
                    Treatment, slope, intercept, r,
                    ifelse(p < 0.001, "<", "="),
                    ifelse(p < 0.001, 0.001, p))
  )

# Plot
p13 <- ggplot(C13_df, aes(x = POM_13C, y = MAOM_13C, color = Treatment)) +
  # Add faint 1:1 reference line behind data
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Field), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = Treatment), method = "lm", se = FALSE, size = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = expression(bold("POM " * delta^{13} * "C (‰)")),
    y = expression(bold("MAOM " * delta^{13} * "C (‰)")),
    color = "Treatment", shape = "Years Since WOR"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-29, -24)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-29, -24)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CN" = "#1F77B4", "WC" = "#FF7F0E"),
                     labels = c("CN" = "Control", "WC" = "WOR")) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("K95" = 16, "K92" = 17, "K74" = 15, "K31" = 3),
    labels = c("K95" = "3", "K92" = "4", "K74" = "6", "K31" = "15")
  ) +
  theme_gray(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = -26, y = -27, label = reg_stats_13C$label[reg_stats_13C$Treatment == "CN"],
           color = "#1F77B4", hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = -26, y = -28, label = reg_stats_13C$label[reg_stats_13C$Treatment == "WC"],
           color = "#FF7F0E", hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold")

print(p13)

png("SFT_13C_scatter_Year.png", width = 6, height = 6, bg = "white", res = 600, units = "in")
print(p13)
dev.off()
```

# OM_Content
```{r}
library(grid)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Filter data and prepare long format
OM_data <- SFT_meta %>%
  select(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment, OM_Content)

OM_long <- OM_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = OM_Content, names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value")

# Set factor levels for consistent x-axis ordering
OM_long$Field <- factor(OM_long$Field, levels = c("K95", "K92", "K74", "K31"))

# Add custom facet label for strip
OM_long$Facet <- "<2 mm Soil"

# Calculate summary statistics per Treatment × Field group
OM_avg <- OM_long %>%
  group_by(Field, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Value), SE = sd(Value) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

# Create boxplot with mean ± SE
OM_plot <- ggplot(OM_long, aes(x = Field, y = Value, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(0.8), color = "black") +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "pointrange",
    aes(group = Treatment),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    shape = 21,
    fill = "black",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = OM_avg,
    aes(x = Field, y = Mean, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE, group = Treatment, fill = Treatment),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.25,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Facet, strip.position = "top") +
  labs(
    y = "Organic Matter Content (%)",
    x = "Years Since WOR"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("K95" = "3", "K92" = "4", "K74" = "6", "K31" = "15")) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("CN" = "#1F77B4", "WC" = "#FF7F0E"),
    labels = c("CN" = "Control", "WC" = "WOR")
  ) +
theme_bw(base_size = 12) +  # ensures font size matches TN plot
theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white"),
  panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white"),
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey80", color = NA),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
  legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
  legend.position = "none",
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
)

# Print
print(OM_plot)

# To save
png("OM_plot_facetstyle_thin_nl.png", width = 4, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600, bg = "white")
print(OM_plot)
dev.off()
```

## Plotting Helix Index 1 (Decomposition) and 2 (Recalcitrance)
```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(rstatix)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsignif)

# Select the columns you want to include
Index_columns <- c("POM_Decomposition_Index", "MAOM_Decomposition_Index",
                   "POM_Recalcitrance_Index", "MAOM_Recalcitrance_Index")

# Gather the data to reshape it and filter columns
SFT_Imeta_long <- SFT_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment, all_of(Index_columns)) %>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "Value", -c(Sample, Field, Block, Treatment))

# Function to remove outliers using IQR
remove_outliers <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  x[x < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) | x > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)] <- NA
  return(x)
}

# Apply outlier removal only to POM indices
SFT_Imeta_long <- SFT_Imeta_long %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  mutate(Value = ifelse(Parameter %in% c("POM_Decomposition_Index", "POM_Recalcitrance_Index"),
                        remove_outliers(Value), Value)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate averages for each Field + Treatment + Parameter
averages <- SFT_Imeta_long %>%
  group_by(Field, Treatment, Parameter) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
            SE = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")

# Define custom order for Field and Parameter
field_order <- c("K95", "K92", "K74", "K31")
parameter_order <- c(
  "POM_Decomposition_Index",
  "MAOM_Decomposition_Index",
  "POM_Recalcitrance_Index",
  "MAOM_Recalcitrance_Index"
)

# Apply factor levels (ordering) to Parameter and Field
SFT_Imeta_long <- SFT_Imeta_long %>%
  mutate(
    Field = factor(Field, levels = field_order),
    Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = parameter_order)
  )
averages <- averages %>%
  mutate(
    Field = factor(Field, levels = field_order),
    Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = parameter_order)
  )

# Create the plot
Decomp_Recal_bxplt <- ggplot(SFT_Imeta_long, aes(x = Field, y = Value, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), show.legend = TRUE) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "pointrange",
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = averages,
                aes(x = Field, y = Mean, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
  labs(y = "Index Value", x = "Years Since WOR") +
  theme_gray(base_size = 12) + 
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CN" = "#1F77B4", "WC" = "#FF7F0E"),
                    labels = c("CN" = "Control", "WC" = "WOR")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("K95" = "3", "K92" = "4",
                              "K74" = "6", "K31" = "15")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Parameter, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(
    Parameter = c(
      "POM_Decomposition_Index"  = "POM Aliphatic C : Aromatic C",
      "MAOM_Decomposition_Index" = "MAOM Aliphatic C : Aromatic C",
      "POM_Recalcitrance_Index"  = "POM Aromatic C : Carboxylic C",
      "MAOM_Recalcitrance_Index" = "MAOM Aromatic C : Carboxylic C"
    )
  ))

# Print the plot
print(Decomp_Recal_bxplt)

# Save the plot
png("SFT_decomp_recal_bxplt2.png", width = 12, height = 6, bg = "white", res = 600, units = "in")
```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggtext)

# Load the data
SFT_subtraction <- readRDS("POM_MAOM_TC_TN_Subtraction.rds")
str(SFT_subtraction)

# Create a new column that combines Block and Treatment for x-axis labeling
SFT_subtraction <- SFT_subtraction %>%
  mutate(Block_Treatment = paste0(Treatment, "_", "B", Block))

# Combine Field, Treatment, and Block into one label for the x-axis
SFT_subtraction <- SFT_subtraction %>%
  mutate(Field_Treatment_Block = paste(Field, Treatment, Block, sep = "_"))

# Reshape the data to long format for easier plotting of both C_total and C_remaining
SFT_long <- SFT_subtraction %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(C_total, C_remaining), names_to = "C_type", values_to = "C_value")

# Define the exact x-axis order you want
x_order <- c(
  paste0("KB31_CN_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB31_WC_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB74_CN_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB74_WC_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB92_CN_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB92_WC_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB95_CN_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB95_WC_", 1:4)
)

# Make sure x-axis order matches the desired order
SFT_long <- SFT_long %>%
  mutate(Field_Treatment_Block = factor(Field_Treatment_Block, levels = x_order))

# Define the exact x-axis order you want
x_order <- c(
  paste0("KB31_CN_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB31_WC_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB74_CN_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB74_WC_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB92_CN_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB92_WC_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB95_CN_", 1:4),
  paste0("KB95_WC_", 1:4)
)

# Make sure x-axis order matches the desired order
SFT_long <- SFT_long %>%
  mutate(Field_Treatment_Block = factor(Field_Treatment_Block, levels = x_order))

# Define custom colors for treatments
label_df <- SFT_subtraction %>%
  distinct(Field_Treatment_Block, Treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    Field_Treatment_Block = factor(Field_Treatment_Block, levels = x_order),
    x_pos = as.numeric(Field_Treatment_Block),
    label_color = ifelse(Treatment == "CN", "#1F77B4", "#FF7F0E")
  )

# Create the plot
C_removal_plot <- ggplot(SFT_long, aes(x = Field_Treatment_Block, y = C_value, color = C_type, group = C_type)) +
  # Add lines for C_total and C_remaining
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  # Facet by SOM
  facet_wrap(~ SOM) +
  # Customize labels
  labs(
    x = "Field x Treatment x Block",
    y = "Total C (%)",
    title = "Total C and C Removal by NaOCl oxidation",
    color = "Total C (%)"
  ) +
  # Add custom colored x-axis labels
  geom_text(
    data = label_df,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = -0.08, label = Field_Treatment_Block, color = Treatment),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 45,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    C_total = "#17becf",
    C_remaining = "#ff7f0e",
    CN = "#1F77B4",
    WC = "#FF7F0E"
  )) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, margin = margin(t = 33)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -8),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

C_removal_plot
```

## Mixed Models - Two-way ANOVAs with lm
The code below is used to compare the fit of different linear mixed-effects models to determine the significance of including certain predictor variables or interaction terms in explaining the variability in the response variable (i.e., SOM, TC, TN, POM_TC, MAOM_TC, POM_TN, and MAOM_TN).

# Statistics for Soil Chem Metadata
```{r}
# Load Packages
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)   # Provides p-values for lmer models
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(DescTools)  
library(rcompanion) # For plotNormalHistogram
library(emmeans)

SFT_meta <- readRDS("SFT_2023_Metadata.rds")
str(SFT_meta) # Need to convert Treatment, Field, Block, and Year to factors
SFT_meta$Treatment <- as.factor(SFT_meta$Treatment)
SFT_meta$Field <- as.factor(SFT_meta$Field)
SFT_meta$Year_of_WOR <- as.factor(SFT_meta$Year_of_WOR)
SFT_meta$Block_ID <- as.factor(SFT_meta$Block_ID)

# The code commented out below is an attempt for multivariate ANOVAs and lmer
# Check residuals of "least" random effects models
#SOM_least <- lmer( OM_Content ~ Year_of_WOR*Treatment  + (1 | Block_ID ) + ( 1 | Block_ID:Treatment), data = SFT_meta) # #Error: boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular'), which implies overfitting
#isSingular(SOM_least, tol = 1e-4) # TRUE
# Check residuals of "most" random effects models
#SOM_most <- lmer( OM_Content ~ Year_of_WOR*Treatment  + (1 | Block_ID ) + ( 1 | Block_ID:Treatment) + 
#( 1 | Block_ID:Year_of_WOR ), data = SFT_meta) # Error: boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')

# Model Fitting - Is there an interaction?
# Fit the model with only main effects
#anova_model_main <- lm(OM_Content ~ Field + Treatment, data = SFT_meta)

# Perform the ANOVA
#anova_results_main <- anova(anova_model_main)

# Display the ANOVA results
#print(anova_results_main)

# Fit the model with main effects and interaction
anova_model_interaction <- lm(OM_Content ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)

# Perform the ANOVA
anova_results_interaction <- anova(anova_model_interaction)

# Display the ANOVA results
print(anova_results_interaction) # Treatment:Field is significant !

# Check residuals of the lm model
plot(anova_model_interaction)
qqnorm(residuals(anova_model_interaction))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(anova_model_interaction))
shapiro.test(residuals(anova_model_interaction))  # Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
#W = 0.93441, p-value = 0.05203

# Try the model with the main effects, interaction, and Block as a random effect
#anova_model_block <- lmer(OM_Content ~ Treatment * Field + (1 | Field:Block_ID), data = SFT_meta)
# Perform the ANOVA
#anova_results_block <- anova(anova_model_block)
# Display the ANOVA results
#print(anova_results_block)

# Lower AIC/BIC suggests better model fit, penalized for complexity
#AIC <- AIC(anova_model_interaction, anova_model_block)
# Interaction model AIC = 35.79022
# Block model AIC = 51.12766
#BIC <- BIC(anova_model_interaction, anova_model_block)
# Interaction model BIC = 48.98184
# Block model BIC = 65.78502

# Residual diagnostics
#par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
#plot(anova_model_block, which = 1)  # Residuals vs Fitted
#qqnorm(residuals(anova_model_block)); qqline(residuals(anova_model_block))
#plotNormalHistogram(residuals(anova_model_block))
#shapiro.test(residuals(anova_model_block))  # Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
# W = 0.92171, p-value = 0.02315

# ----------------------------
# TRANSFORMATIONS
# ----------------------------

## 1. Log10 transformation
#SFT_meta$log10_SOM <- log10(SFT_meta$OM_Content)
#log_SOM_lm <- lm(log10_SOM ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)
#shapiro.test(residuals(log_SOM_lm))
# W = 0.98555, p-value = 0.9351
#qqnorm(residuals(log_SOM_lm))
#plotNormalHistogram(residuals(log_SOM_lm))

## 2. Square-root transformation
#SFT_meta$sqrt_SOM <- sqrt(SFT_meta$OM_Content)
#sqrt_SOM_lm <- lm(sqrt_SOM ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)
#shapiro.test(residuals(sqrt_SOM_lm))
# W = 0.96197, p-value = 0.3106
#qqnorm(residuals(sqrt_SOM_lm))
#plotNormalHistogram(residuals(sqrt_SOM_lm))

## 3. Inverse transformation
SFT_meta$inv_SOM <- 1 / SFT_meta$OM_Content
inv_SOM_lm <- lm(inv_SOM ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)
shapiro.test(residuals(inv_SOM_lm))  # looks best, and highest p-value
# W = 0.98953, p-value = 0.9855
qqnorm(residuals(inv_SOM_lm))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(inv_SOM_lm))

## 4. Cube-root transformation
#SFT_meta$cbrt_SOM <- SFT_meta$OM_Content^(1/3)
#cbrt_SOM_lm <- lm(cbrt_SOM ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)
#shapiro.test(residuals(cbrt_SOM_lm))
# W = 0.97138, p-value = 0.5383
#qqnorm(residuals(cbrt_SOM_lm))
#plotNormalHistogram(residuals(cbrt_SOM_lm))

# ------------------------------------
# SOM MODEL (Assuming inverse is best)
# ------------------------------------
anova(inv_SOM_lm)
#Response: inv_SOM
#                Df   Sum Sq  Mean Sq F value    Pr(>F)    
#Treatment        1 0.080968 0.080968 41.9446 1.069e-06 ***
#Field            3 0.005625 0.001875  0.9714 0.4224930    
#Treatment:Field  3 0.047486 0.015829  8.1999 0.0006249 ***
#Residuals       24 0.046329 0.001930  

# ----------------------
# POST-HOC PAIRWISE COMPARISONS
# ----------------------
# Compare treatments within each field
SOM_Treatment_PH <- emmeans(inv_SOM_lm, ~ Treatment | Field)
pairwise_contrasts_SOM <- contrast(SOM_Treatment_PH, method = "pairwise")

summary(pairwise_contrasts_SOM)
plot(SOM_Treatment_PH)
```

## Decomposition (1) and Recalcitrance (2) Index Values
Sample POM 4 (K92_B5_CN) needs to be removed before the following model fitting can be performed. Essentially, the spectral subtraction for this sample yielded negative peaks, and the resulting Index values are sometimes "Inf", NA, or 0.000. This samples is clearly an outlier, and is impeding ANOVA due to the following error:

anova_model_main <- lm(POM_Decomposition_Index ~ Field + Treatment, data = SFT_meta)
Error in lm.fit(x, y, offset = offset, singular.ok = singular.ok, ...) : 
  NA/NaN/Inf in 'y'

Due to the structure of the data table (Sample ID as rows, with POM and MAOM values as columns), the simplest solution is to create a copy of the metadata, with the problematic POM sample removed:
```{r}
# Create a filtered dataset only for POM analysis
SFT_meta_POM <- SFT_meta %>%
  filter(Sample != "K92_B5_CN")  # exclude bad sample
```
  
# MAOM Index I (Decomposition) Margenot
```{r}
# Model Fitting - Is there an interaction?
# Fit the model with only main effects
anova_model_main <- lm(MAOM_Index_I ~ Field + Treatment, data = SFT_meta)

# Perform the ANOVA

# Display the ANOVA results
print(anova_results_main)

# Fit the model with main effects and interaction
anova_model_interaction <- lm(MAOM_Index_I ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta)

# Perform the ANOVA

# Display the ANOVA results
```

```{r}
# MAOM Decomposition
# ------------------------------------
# Outlier removal (IQR) for MAOM Decomposition Index
# ------------------------------------
remove_outliers <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  x[x < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) | x > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)] <- NA
  return(x)
}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------
# Outlier removal (IQR) for MAOM Recalcitrance Index
# ------------------------------------
remove_outliers <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  x[x < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) | x > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)] <- NA
  return(x)
}
```

Due to the structure of the data table (Sample ID as rows, with POM and MAOM values as columns), the simplest solution is to create a copy of the metadata, with the problematic POM sample removed:
```{r}
# Create a filtered dataset only for POM analysis
SFT_meta_POM <- SFT_meta %>%
  filter(Sample != "K92_B5_CN")  # exclude bad sample
```

```{r}
# W = 0.63332, p-value = 1.382e-07

plotNormalHistogram(residuals(log1p_POM_Decomposition_Index_lm))

# 6. Box-Cox transformation
library(MASS)
# Fit the base linear model
boxcox_POM_mod <- lm(POM_Decomposition_Index ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta_POM)

# Plot Box-Cox profile
bc <- boxcox(boxcox_POM_mod, lambda = seq(-2, 2, 0.1))

# Extract optimal lambda
lambda_opt <- bc$x[which.max(bc$y)]
lambda_opt

# Apply Box-Cox transform manually (if lambda ≠ 0)
if (abs(lambda_opt) > 1e-6) {
  SFT_meta_POM$boxcox_POM_Decomp <- (SFT_meta_POM$POM_Decomposition_Index^lambda_opt - 1) / lambda_opt
} else {
  # If lambda ~ 0, use log transformation
  SFT_meta_POM$boxcox_POM_Decomp <- log(SFT_meta_POM$POM_Decomposition_Index)
}

# Fit model with Box-Cox transformed response
boxcox_POM_model <- lm(boxcox_POM_Decomp ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta_POM)

# Evaluate residuals
shapiro.test(resid(boxcox_POM_model))
# W = 0.89326, p-value = 0.004912
qqnorm(resid(boxcox_POM_model), main = "QQ Plot - Box-Cox Transformed Residuals")
qqline(resid(boxcox_POM_model))

summary(boxcox_POM_model)

# 7. Yeo-Johnson Transformation
library(bestNormalize)

# Estimate optimal Yeo-Johnson lambda
yj_obj <- yeojohnson(SFT_meta_POM$POM_Decomposition_Index)
SFT_meta_POM$yj_POM_Decomposition_Index <- predict(yj_obj)

# Fit base model
yj_POM_model <- lm(yj_POM_Decomposition_Index ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta_POM)

shapiro.test(resid(yj_POM_model))
# W = 0.93416, p-value = 0.05697
plot(yj_POM_model)
qqnorm(resid(yj_POM_model)); qqline(resid(yj_POM_model))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(yj_POM_model))
summary(yj_POM_model)

# ------------------------------------
# POM_Decomposition_Index MODEL (Assuming yeo-johnson is best)
# ------------------------------------
anova(yj_POM_model)
# Treatment is not significant F = 0.1304  (p =  0.7212662)
# Field (or Year) is significant F = 10.5914 (p = 0.0001434) ***
# Treatment:Field is not significant F = 1.2059  (p = 0.3298407)

# ----------------------
# POST-HOC PAIRWISE COMPARISONS
# ----------------------
# Compare treatments within each field
emmeans_results_POM_Decomposition_Index <- emmeans(yj_POM_model, ~ Treatment | Field)
pairwise_contrasts_POM_Decomposition_Index <- contrast(emmeans_results_POM_Decomposition_Index, method = "pairwise")

# View results
summary(pairwise_contrasts_POM_Decomposition_Index)
plot(emmeans_results_POM_Decomposition_Index)  # Optional: visualize treatment differences by field
```

# POM Index 2 (Recalcitrance) Helix (with outlier)
```{r}
# Model Fitting - Is there an interaction?
# Fit the model with only main effects
anova_model_main <- lm(POM_Recalcitrance_Index ~ Field + Treatment, data = SFT_meta_POM)

# Perform the ANOVA
anova_results_main <- anova(anova_model_main)

# Display the ANOVA results
print(anova_results_main)

# Fit the model with main effects and interaction
anova_model_interaction <- lm(POM_Recalcitrance_Index ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta_POM)

# Perform the ANOVA
anova_results_interaction <- anova(anova_model_interaction)

# Display the ANOVA results
print(anova_results_interaction) # Year_of_WOR:Treatment is not significant !

# Check residuals of the lm model
POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm <- lm(POM_Recalcitrance_Index ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta_POM)

plot(POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm)
qqnorm(residuals(POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))
shapiro.test(residuals(POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))
# W = 0.41597, p-value = 5.198e-10

# Try the model with the main effects, interaction, and Block as a random effect
anova_model_block <- lmer(POM_Recalcitrance_Index ~ Treatment * Field + (1 | Field:Block_ID), data = SFT_meta_POM)
# Fit is singular! random effect term is not useful
# Perform the ANOVA
anova_results_block <- anova(anova_model_block)
# Display the ANOVA results
print(anova_results_block)

# Lower AIC/BIC suggests better model fit, penalized for complexity
AIC <- AIC(anova_model_interaction, anova_model_block)
# Interaction model AIC = 283.3449
# Block model AIC = 234.5368
BIC <- BIC(anova_model_interaction, anova_model_block)
# Interaction model BIC = 296.2508
# Block model BIC = 248.8767

# Residual diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(anova_model_block, which = 1)  # Residuals vs Fitted
qqnorm(residuals(anova_model_block))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(anova_model_block))
shapiro.test(residuals(anova_model_block))  # Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
# W = 0.41597, p-value = 5.198e-10

# ----------------------------
# TRANSFORMATIONS
# ----------------------------

## 1. Log10 transformation
SFT_meta_POM$log10_POM_Recalcitrance_Index <- log10(SFT_meta_POM$POM_Recalcitrance_Index)
log_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm <- lm(log10_POM_Recalcitrance_Index ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta_POM)
shapiro.test(residuals(log_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))
# W = 0.75831, p-value = 9.549e-06
qqnorm(residuals(log_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(log_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))

## 2. Square-root transformation
SFT_meta_POM$sqrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index <- sqrt(SFT_meta_POM$POM_Recalcitrance_Index)
sqrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm <- lm(sqrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index ~ Treatment * Field , data = SFT_meta_POM)
shapiro.test(residuals(sqrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))
# W = 0.50827, p-value = 4.547e-09
qqnorm(residuals(sqrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(sqrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))

## 3. Inverse transformation
SFT_meta_POM$inv_POM_Recalcitrance_Index <- 1 / (SFT_meta_POM$POM_Recalcitrance_Index)
inv_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm <- lm(inv_POM_Recalcitrance_Index ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta_POM)
shapiro.test(residuals(inv_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm)) # looks best, and highest p-value
# W = 0.96057, p-value = 0.302
qqnorm(residuals(inv_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(inv_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))

## 4. Cube-root transformation
SFT_meta_POM$cbrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index <- SFT_meta_POM$POM_Recalcitrance_Index^(1/3)
cbrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm <- lm(cbrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index ~ Treatment * Field, data = SFT_meta_POM)
shapiro.test(residuals(cbrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))
# W = 0.57513, p-value = 2.605e-08
qqnorm(residuals(cbrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))
plotNormalHistogram(residuals(cbrt_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm))

# ------------------------------------
# POM_Recalcitrance_Index MODEL (Assuming inverse is best)
# ------------------------------------
anova(inv_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm)
# Treatment is not significant F = 0.409  (p = 0.5288)
# Field (or Year) is significant F = 1.679 (p = 0.1993)
# Treatment:Field is not significant F = 0.246  (p = 0.8633)

# ----------------------
# POST-HOC PAIRWISE COMPARISONS --> Nothing significant here
# ----------------------
# Compare treatments within each field
emmeans_results_POM_Recalcitrance_Index <- emmeans(inv_POM_Recalcitrance_Index_lm, ~ Treatment | Field)
pairwise_contrasts_POM_Recalcitrance_Index <- contrast(emmeans_results_POM_Recalcitrance_Index, method = "pairwise")

# View results
summary(pairwise_contrasts_POM_Recalcitrance_Index)
plot(emmeans_results_POM_Recalcitrance_Index)  # Optional: visualize treatment differences by field
```

# POM Index 2 (Recalcitrance) Helix (outliers filtered)

```{r}
# POM Recalcitrance
# ------------------------------------
# Outlier removal (IQR) for POM Recalcitrance Index
# ------------------------------------
remove_outliers <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  x[x < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) | x > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)] <- NA
  return(x)
}
```
